title: Keeping the contract
description:
Implement three functions whose pages state preconditions, half-open ranges and an exception guarantee (lesson 1.04).


```cpp-norun
std::size_t findIndex(const std::vector<int>& v, int value);
```

Returns the index of the first element equal to `value`, or `v.size()` if there is none (the "one past the end" convention). Never throws.


```cpp-norun
std::size_t removeRange(std::vector<int>& v, std::size_t first, std::size_t last);
```

Removes the elements with indices in the half-open range `[first, last)` and returns how many were removed. The elements after the range keep their order.

- **Preconditions** (checked): `first <= last` and `last <= v.size()`.
- **Exceptions**: throws `std::out_of_range` if a precondition does not hold; `v` is then unchanged.


```cpp-norun
void appendAll(std::vector<std::string>& dest, const std::vector<std::string>& src, std::size_t maxTotal);
```

Appends copies of every element of `src` to the end of `dest`, in order.

- **Exceptions**: throws `std::length_error` if `dest.size() + src.size()` would be greater than `maxTotal`.
- **Exception guarantee**: strong. If the function throws, for this or any other reason, `dest` is exactly as it was.
- **Note**: `src` and `dest` may be the same vector; then `dest` ends up with its contents twice.
hints: For `removeRange`, check both preconditions before touching the vector, so that "unchanged on throw" is automatic.

The strong guarantee is easiest to give by building the result in a new vector and swapping it in only when everything has succeeded: a `swap` cannot throw. It also makes appending a vector to itself safe.
Write the size check without overflow: `dest.size() + src.size() > maxTotal` can wrap around for huge values; `src.size() > maxTotal || dest.size() > maxTotal - src.size()` cannot.
